subject: Looping through a vector of paired indices (i,j) vs two for loops

messages.author: 9ecba0932442fd58
messages.subject: Looping through a vector of paired indices (i,j) vs two for loops
parts: I'm looking to do some link prediction on a graph using the Mixed Membership Stochastic Block model. To get AUC scores, I need to loop only through a subset of edges so that I could use my learned latent variables to predict the rest. I'm wondering what the best way of enforcing that would be. Is is possible to loop through a vector containing a list of valid edge indices? Most of the examples I'm seeing show a double for loop to loop through the generation of edges.
